name: Garna's Bloodfists
text:
You start the game with 2 less life.
Whenever a creature you control enters, if it's the first creature to enter the battlefield under your control this game, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if it's your second turn, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if it's your third turn, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if it's your fourth turn, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
